  • Hose end: -5 hose (1/4" ID) to -14 hose (7/8" ID)
  • Connection: 3/8" NPTF (3/8-18) to 3/4" NPTF (3/4-14)

Hose sizes are SAE dash sizes; for R5 and R14 hose the inside diameter is given beside each one, because it is not the dash size in sixteenths.

Pressure rating

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for this hose end. An assembly is rated to the lower of the hose and the end connection; tell us the hose and working pressure and we will confirm the fitting.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table, or send the hose type and size and the end connection, and Indus engineering will confirm it. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
